skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental aspects of economic and social policies, approaches of economists to economic policy, tasks of policymakers, objectives of economic policies, and the economic policy system.
Grasp the basic knowledge of policy formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation.
Develop skills in policy formulation, implementation, and evaluation.
Enhance skills in group work, communication, conflict resolution, and time management.
Develop decision-making skills to solve policy issues.
Develop independent work skills, responsibility, social responsibility, professional ethics, and effective management of work capacity.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate economic policies.
Develop skills in presenting and communicating policy analysis effectively.
Develop research skills to understand and evaluate economic policies.
